value.rationale: A complete constructive case of the published lower-semi-frame reweighting problem on every locally finite graph. The theorem sharply separates universally attainable unbounded Laplacian spectral gaps from bounded-degree two-sided frame constraints, with amenability as exact obstruction, including previously difficult amenable graph classes.
